rules.description: Verification/execution states are drawn by components/status-pill.tsx and nowhere else
notes: exempt: components/status-pill.tsx — the canonical implementation — this IS the vocabulary
exempt: components/run-status-badge.tsx — a wrapper: maps run status onto ExecutionPill and paints nothing itself

exempt: components/run-row.tsx — status words are comparison logic (elapsed display, stoppable, sort) and status paint goes through RunStatusBadge; the one styled line is the destructive Interrupt action button, not a pill
exempt: lib/kanban.ts — the single source of kanban labels/dots, deliberately data-only
exempt: components/failure/classify.ts — failure-class vocabulary (UX spec §7), not a pill
exempt: components/failure/failure-card.tsx — failure-class vocabulary (UX spec §7), one error model

rules.description: The loading shimmer is defined exactly once
A green check never renders without a verdict to link to (UX spec §8.8)
notes: VerificationPill downgrades an unbacked `passed` and gates its link

rules.description: `error` (harness malfunction) is not styled like `failed` (product defect)
